## Summary of Changes

Provide a clear and concise description of the proposed changes. Mention any relevant issue numbers (e.g. `Fixes #12`).

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Template enhancement or new layout
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactor

## Testing & Verification

Describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] `npm run check` passes with zero syntax errors
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds without build issues
- [ ] Tested across desktop and mobile viewports
- [ ] Verified print / PDF export fidelity
